{{Quote|Rhen Var is merely an outpost… So: Nam Chorios?|Wilhuff Tarkin eliminates Rhen Var from the list of potential targets for the ''Carrion Spike''|<ref name="Trkn" />}}
'''Rhen Var''' was a [[planet]] with frigid environments<ref name="USW" /> in the [[Rhen Var system]] of the [[Thanium sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was located near the [[Galidraan system]]<ref name="Trkn" /> in the grid R-6 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" />

==History==
During the [[galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]] deployed [[clone cold assault trooper]]s on the world; [[troop]]s specifically equipped to deal with cold environments.<ref name="USW" />

During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], an [[Rhen Var Imperial outpost|Imperial outpost]] was located on Rhen Var. After the [[Mission to Murkhana|stolen]] Imperial [[corvette]] ''[[Carrion Spike]]'' [[Attack on Galidraan Station|attacked Imperial facilities]] in the Galidraan [[star system]], the planet's outpost was considered as one of the potential targets for the corvette by [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Due to the relative unimportance of the outpost on Rhen Var, Tarkin decided that the Imperial assets on the planet [[Nam Chorios]] were a more likely choice for the [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] [[pilot]]ing the stolen [[starship]].<ref name="Trkn" />

The [[stormtrooper]] deserter [[Sardis Ramsin]] mentioned Rhen Var while complaining about the heat of the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] on an Imperial incident report form he filled out.<ref name="Born in the Storm">{{StoryCite|story=Born in the Storm|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rhen Var was first mentioned in [[canon]] in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2014]] novel [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']].<ref name="Trkn" /> It first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]].<ref name="Redemption 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]]</ref>
